definitions.explanation: Indicates that the displayed price does not include consumption tax, which will be added at checkout.

examples.japanese: {税抜|ぜいぬき}{九百八十円|きゅうひゃくはちじゅうえん}です。
⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{税抜|ぜいぬき}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧です。
{税抜|ぜいぬき}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Both the price excluding tax and including tax are written.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: price excluding tax
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: tax-exclusive display
- {税抜|ぜいぬき}○○⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: ○○ yen excluding tax

FORMS:
Often written as {抜|ぬき} on price tags.

USAGE:
In Japan, stores can display prices either with or without tax. Always check whether prices are ⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧ or {税抜|ぜいぬき}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧: tax included
- ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧: consumption tax
- ⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: base price (before tax)
